items.title: Designing a Very Efficient Data Center
items.building_phase_specific: Prineville first OCP facility / Prineville 1 class
items.architecture_evidence: no chiller plant; no cooling towers/pumps; 100% OA evaporative cooling and humidification; winter return-air mix in penthouse; ductless/hot-aisle containment; capability to install IEC if needed (NOT installed)

items.title: Open Compute Project Data Center v1.0
items.reference: Open Compute Data Center v1.0 (Park); local excerpt via public spec copies
items.architecture_evidence: OA louvers → mix with return → filters → ECH mist → mist eliminators → fan wall → cold aisle; cold aisle 65–85 F; dewpoint min 41.9 F; 65% RH max; no chillers/compressors for IT; RO/softener; VFD fans; BMS; Appendix B indirect cooling is optional/future
items.notes: Appendix B IEC is capability/spec option

items.title: Water Efficiency at Facebook's Prineville Data Center
items.architecture_evidence: built-up penthouse; 100% OA economizer; direct ECH misting; no chillers or cooling towers; single-pass with recirculate or exhaust; water in supply-air stream not cooling-tower blowdown

items.title: Learning Lessons at the Prineville Data Center
items.architecture_evidence: confirms penthouse chiller-less OA+evap; damper/recirculation control exists; humidification spray can run 100%
items.notes: fault sequence is not the design intent

items.title: Facebook details efficiency at Prineville / penthouse video
items.issuer: Data Center Dynamics / Data Center Knowledge
items.reference: Jay Park penthouse tour; MeeFog high-pressure mist
items.architecture_evidence: louvers, mixing with hot-aisle air, filter banks, pressurized water mist, fan wall, winter recirculation heating

items.title: How Facebook Upgraded the Outside Air Cooling System at Their Prineville Data Center
items.temporal_applicability: fog system remained; pump lubrication upgrade
items.architecture_evidence: MeeFog 28 units / ~6600 nozzles; still OA+fog not CRAH hall cooling; water-lubricated pump swap
items.current_use: confirms mist technology persistence at a Prineville hall
items.notes: do not treat vendor claims as campus-wide later architecture

items.title: Crook County PRN1 addition mechanical/chiller permits
items.architecture_evidence: chilled-water, CRAH, chiller for personnel and IT; additional roof chiller operational 2024-02-02; heat-rejection type NOT stated
items.notes: not campus-wide; not used historically to retune holdout

items.title: 217-19-000276-MECH CCO1/CCO2 mechanical
items.architecture_evidence: water rooms, IWS/IWR, piping serving ECH in Data Hall A, data-hall supply water, CRAC in electrical room, refrigeration lines. No explicit chiller/tower. ECH matches OCP evaporative cooling/humidification acronym.
items.notes: CRAC in electrical room is not hall architecture

items.title: StatePoint Liquid Cooling system for data centers
items.architecture_evidence: SPLC exists; intended where direct cooling not feasible; direct evaporative remains preferred where climate allows
items.notes: NEVER PRINEVILLE CONFIRMED from this source

items.title: Meta existing-DC outside air / mixing / misting / fan-wall description
items.architecture_evidence: OA, mixing, evaporative/humidification misting, fan walls, SAT/RH/airflow control exist in the fleet
items.notes: does not by itself confirm later Prineville buildings
